newsitem.title: USA: Coastal wins two Australian offshore permits.
newsitem.headline: Coastal wins two Australian offshore permits.

text.p: The Coastal Corp said it has been awarded two permits for Areas AC96-3 and AC96-4, which lie about 450 miles west of the city of Darwin, by The Department of Mines and Energy of the Northern Territory of Australia.
Coastal will have a 50-percent working interest in Area AC96-3 and a 40-percent working interest in Area AC96-4 and will be the operator for both areas.

Other participants in Area AC96-3 include Asamera Australia Limited, part of Gulf Canada Resources Ltd, with 40-percent and New Zealand-based energy company Todd Petroleum Mining Company Limited with a 10-percent working interest. In Area AC96-4, Asamera Australia Limited and Hardy Petroleum Ltd each have a 30 percent interest. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
